To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we synthesized several novel amides of 11-keto-urs-12-ene-24-carboxylic acid, and these compounds were found to be more cytotoxic than 11-keto-B-boswellic or acetyl-11-ket0-B-boswellich acids.
11-keto- b-boswellic acids are more cytotoxic than ursolic acid and that 24-amides of 11-keto b-boswellica acid are the most cytotoxic compounds of this series.

the 24-amide derivatives of 11-keto-ursolic acid and 11-keto-acetyl-11-ketoboswellic acid were synthesized and evaluated for their cytotoxic activity against two cancer cell lines (ovarian carcinoma A2780 and breast adenocarcinoma MCF7) and nonmalignant NIH 3T 3 fibroblasts.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and biological evaluation of novel 11-keto-\(\beta\)-boswellic acid amides.
the synthesis and evaluation of 11-keto-ursolic acid derivatives modified at position C-24.
the synthesis of new amides or hydraides derived from 11-keto-β-boswellic and acetyl-11-ketoboswellic acids.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the amide and hydrazide derivatives of 11-keto- and acetyl-11-ketob-boswellic acids were synthesized and evaluated as antitumor agents in vitro.
the 3a, 12b, 24R-configuration of the amide derivatives is essential for the high antitumor activity.
the cytotoxicity of 11-keto-derivatives is higher than that of the 3-acetylated derivatives.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 11-oxo group is a key structural element for cytotoxicity of boswellic acid derivatives.
the cytotoxicity of the 11-oxo-b-boswel lic acid derivatives depends on the substitution pattern at the 3-position.

we have synthesized a series of 11-keto-B-boswellic acids derivatives and evaluated them in vitro against two human tumor cell types (A2780 ovarian and MCF7 breast carcinoma cell lines) and a nonmalignant cell type (NIH 30T3 mouse fibroblastic cell lines).
The main takeaway from our work is that
amide and hydrazide derivatives of 11-keto-B-boswellic and 11-keto-acetyl-B-boswel lic acids are promising compounds for further investigation of their antitumor properties.
amides and hydrazides of AKBA and KBA are more cytotoxic than the parent compounds and that amides of AKBA with a long alkyl chain at C-24 have the best antitumor activity.
amide derivatives of 11-keto-B-boswellic acids can be prepared and that they are more cytotoxic than AKBA or KBA.
